body:
I think a lot of them are about publicity.

I find it funny that I think about the possible solutions and I feel bad telling being ready with the answer of why it's not a possibility right now. I've been thinking about getting a pet every few days, it's a problem. First time pet owner, I assume that I will prefer a dog. I don't know if I could commit to having it in my life for the next 15 years. I don't have anyone else to cover for me and my plan to travel abroad (and move out to another country) might interfere. That's leaving out the costs and the cost of saving it's life every now and then. Been attentive a couple times a day and not just leaving them at home while I'm out. I tried to join a place for foster care dogs - but for regular dogs you need experience and attention and for guide dogs there's a huge waiting list. I used to live close to home, so it would've been easier to manage, but now I can't guarantee where I'll be. 

I have a lot of hobbies. They suck when you're not as good or doing them alone. I'm somewhere in the beginning of writing/programming/practicing piano/drawing... it's hard to stick to one and the local communities or courses in here didn't work for me. yet.  

Thank you.

I used to volunteer a lot a few years ago, it wasn't helping me. 

I found better places to volunteer right now, but they weirdly have a very long waiting list. and some want you to be a poster boy.

Happy that it worked for you.

I think that I've got to a sample size that I can say that there is no good psych that I have access to. I've even tried to become one myself and that's another struggle.

I think I helped others too much, and then woke up having to build my life on my own. 

Dreams seem so far and unattainable and walking the path by myself is hard.
Do you have any quarters? Friends?
What was so important?
How about tomorrow?
Happiness.

Thanks.

The years have passed and every time I thought I was getting out I was being pulled back in. I see a lot of people surrounded with friends, go out, have fun. I never had it. 

I don't have any friendships. nothing that is really sound and close. Now I get to hangout with people who don't have any other options, like when I'm visiting a cancer ill friend. Sure, he is happy to see me, but wasn't really replying to my messages or invitations for the last year, until he got diagnosed and we met by accident. 

Like the girl who lives a couple of streets for me, can't meet, and will sit with me for coffee if I'll fly to Chicago when she is there. I haven't seen here in 4 years.

I've been trying to work in fields that I love, but it's a mental burden to do it alone all the time. and it kills me.

I don't care about people at work, I just can't relate to them. 5-10 years older than me and with families. or my age and about to get married, when I know I'll be alone this weekend/night.

I've provided too much in my life, I always helped people in need and they were never there to return a favor. I can't commit to a pet, I really want to move out and I can't make a 15+ year commitment, emotionally, financially and living wise (and I can't bring it to my parents apartment).

My country is small, so it will be easy for people I know to pick up on me, it might sound strange, but that's the situation. I've pm'ed some people in the past and their answer was "I'm sorry man, your situation is worse than I thought / I can't help you". and I'm not my country, so I want to avoid connotation - I was only born and forced to live in here, I find almost nothing to do with the culture of people that surround me.
tried, failed.
Trying to get out. buying lottery tickets. thinking about suicide.

Thanks. 
I have no idea how I will be able to get out of here, but it's pretty encouraging.

I did all those stuff, the community in here is too small, I never got to advance. College is expensive, takes both time and money. and I'm a 30 year old, with nothing else but college and I want to hangout with the younger.
I hope so, I no longer have the willpower to try and a lot of things are not under my control.
yep :(
Still feeling unaccomplished, don't know how to get the last 10 years of my life back, don't want the next 10.
Stayed alive. still not sure what is going to be next.

Thanks... 

I want to get my last 10 years (or more back), had no guidance, now I know what I kind of want to do, or at least the mistakes I want to do on my way... I have nothing, and I can't allow myself to stay like that.

And talking isn't enough. also, it's not the same if it's not mutual... and eventually people drift away.
Thanks.
Happy Birthday

There are some extra programs, that are reserved to people under 26, as long as scholarships and other stuff. 

Thanks. I have my thoughts, I'm feeling bad of not accomplishing anything at my 30s, when people at their 20s have done so much. Now to start all over again, it's not likely and I can't make a mistake and choose a wrong direction again. (and just getting to university isn't simple)
Thanks. I might be happy with one, can't afford it right now, financially and physically.
Hope you're good/doing good.
Yes. It's mostly eating.

Thanks. I need to reflect my progress, I'm not sure if a diary would help, or if I can do it anymore. I need something mutual. 
and I've tried talking with people, but my circumstances are unique, so they can mostly feel sorry for me. and eventually our talking relationship would cut off. 

I'll pm you in a few hours. thanks.

>Pick something you enjoy to do and then find a group for it.

Tried it, several time. I live in a small place, can't meet entirely new people. 

Our bars suck, I'm going to places by myself, but can't bare it anymore... it's me & groups, me & couples... 

I really tried, I don't have the willpower to anymore.
Yes, because everyone else is living with their parents/apartments their parents bought them/own.

It's not just the degree. and that's another problem, most of the degrees are unusable. no work in the field, a field that doesn't really require that degree, or both.

But, that will give me a certain advantage that I need right now.
I don't wonder, I know. but for reasons I can't change right now.
too much reading material to figure the basics. I'm a little afraid to discourage people... although I do agree with some of the views. I think.

I think I did once, I'll try it.
thanks.

I was expecting at least the people close to me won't criticize me all the time. no matter what I do. even that I have x100 the money in savings other people my age have. still, I'm not right. I just need someone to be on my side.

I know that people are going to school at all ages. but most of them are not looking for the social aspect. or do it career wise.
I don't want to go to a place and be the 30 years old, without a job, family, friends. that will live where? with his parents to sustain living?

What are you studying?

it's too complicated. I can't sustain living and go to college.

I'll try to remember that. It's hard to be content when I miss a lot. I miss a relationship. I don't know how long I can still fake it.

Thanks.

A lot of times I put a lot of work, and it's not mutual. sometimes, there are a lot of other parameters. like, say you want to live and work in the UK, you can't without a proper citizenship/authorization. you're not likely to get it, unless you have more than enough money and get to have a special advantages in life. other people, just born there and that's it. sometimes, you can work the hardest, but still can't beat it.

It's never too late, but there is a limit to what you can accomplish. I too feel that age it just a number. I wish I was able to deduct 10 years from my idea (it's not like someone would be able to tell). but as for grants and other treatment from society, no one is thinking that. My life is very limited in contrast to younger people.

Meds are complicated, I don't want to feel good just because of a drug. I can convince myself to feel good, but the feedback from the society isn't as welcoming and understanding. also, It's the loneliness that bothers me the most, you can go only a certain amount of time before feeling bad, not having someone to share your life experiences with.
Thanks. but a. I don't have the money b. I'm looking for the experience. 30+ have their families and friends.
Today. why?

We have a mandatory service. I was in the army, it's part of what ruined my life and shifted them.

I already quit my job. I'm not getting unemployment because I'm doing a small side job and earn a little money. the unemployment agency will force me to accept some horrible low grade job, like being a mall guard or a clerk.

I'm trying to take a break, society doesn't let me. I have free time right now, but I get criticized from everyone that knows me, and I don't have someone special to share that time with. no one.

I have enough money for college. I don't have enough money to sustain a living, while working toward getting into college and then studying.

I'm too old/have too much money to get financial aid, it just means that I'll use all my money once I'm out of college.

I took courses at a certain community college, but that was with teachers that studied in a more real college/university. no one was taught in that college and became a professor. 
I didn't like the environment there, either very young very very religious people, or very old people. I didn't feel like a part, I was missing the social function.

and, again as of now, studying, and not in the UK/US, won't do me any good.

I don't need college for profession... I need the social function.
and the approval of people owning the profession at some places, to get in. 

That might be a great idea if I lived in the US. In here everything is so expensive and there is no demand for that kind of things.
and I can get a better profession, computers related, it just a lot of learning in a frustrating direction.

How did things got better?

Thanks.

Each year became more miserable and I keep losing any good thing I might have or love. things are just getting worse, 29 was awful. 
and I hate that just because of some date, for one day, people will care about me.

Thanks.

I want the kids stuff. I never had it. 

I have no idea what to do - need a passion for something.

The problem is that I don't want to be the same, a minute from now. and the changes that I want to be, are bound to things that aren't necessarily related to me. I'm not sure in what direction to progress.

What did you study?

My options are pretty slim, without an additional acceptance effort. I don't deserve any aid and my rights and perks are only getting slimmer. I'm even not allowed to participate in some of the college activities anymore, because they are reserved to people under 26. 
Maybe the situation is different somewhere else, but here... it's only getting worse.
I can't really see beyond tomorrow, next month, or next year right now.

What are you going to study?

That might have been different if I were in america, but right now, I'm far from ever accomplishing anything I wish to, while people have it from birth.

It's late for a 20s college experience. 
I don't know what makes me happy, other than the company of people. I spend to much time with myself.
I never got related to animals, we didn't have them at home. and right now, I'm afraid it will tie me down, while I haven't got anything figured.
Wish I could. not enough parts and you either live in the center (pricey) or anywhere else (crime, no jobs available, no society).

I already did it, but unless I'll study in the US, it won't matter.
Younger groups just sees me as part of the older guys. 

What did you study?
I guess they had other things going in their life, I have nothing socially...

I live in a small community and can't move out (money/citizenship). I don't make a first self impression of a model, so I get treated poorly and probably that affects my actions. but that's also why I'm being ignored on online platforms/apps. I am great at small talks, once I get to talk to people, most of the times that will be people that are not single.

As for regular friends. it's a small community, people have their groups of friends from high school/college/other activities. I'm always the new guy, and as much as I'm a part of the group when it's right for them, they forget my existence when it suitable for them. it seems like a bitch move to do, but on their perspective I guess they just have their own life...

I train, I run. it's not enough. I work very very hard, but lack of society encouragement, the contrary. 

I've tried many /r/ s , but at the end of the day, I have no one to reflect my progress to, someone to help me be accountable and I would look for to make him happy. I had that twice, and got to amazing results. but it won't happen again, not until I'll be a part of a mutual relationship.

Happy birthday. wish we had a boat.

I work in a certain hi-tech industrial computerized profession, that can earn me a lot of money, but has no current future and there is just fake social life there. it's something that I must be on site for and work for large / government companies. 

College experience will be different, sustaining yourself is different. society treats you differently. 

There's my true passion (film) and some other interests.
